description: Compare a candidate skill or routing change with the baseline on paired held-out tasks and decide promote or retain.

inputs.name: objective
inputs.description: What the task must achieve, from the task record.

inputs.name: acceptanceCriteria
inputs.description: Conditions the result is checked against.

outputs.name: evaluation
outputs.description: Wins, losses, regressions and a promote or retain decision with its rule.

steps.description: Read baseline and candidate results for the same held-out tasks. Refuse unpaired or missing entries.
For each task, classify the candidate as a win, loss or tie against the baseline. A loss on a task the baseline passed is a regression.
Apply the promotion rules exactly as written. Correctness regressions outweigh any aggregate gain.
steps.evidence: The rule applied and its inputs.

steps.description: Write the decision with counts, regressions and the rule that decided it.
